definitions.explanation: A place that is far off in distance. Used as a noun referring to a remote location, often in contrast to nearby areas.

examples.japanese: {遠方|えんぽう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{遠方|えんぽう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いらっしゃいます→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧。
examples.english: We also have customers from distant places.

examples.japanese: {遠方|えんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Since I live far away, I rarely have the chance to meet up.

notes:
A somewhat formal or literary word for a distant place. In everyday speech, ⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧ or ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧ is more common, but {遠方|えんぽう} appears frequently in written language, announcements, and polite speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠方|えんぽう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ — from far away
- {遠方|えんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ — to live far away
- {遠方|えんぽう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧ — customers/guests from afar
- {遠方|えんぽう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧ — delivery to distant locations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧ — far away; more casual and commonly used in daily speech
- ⟦{遠隔|えんかく}→遠隔：14381_enkaku⟧ — remote; used for technology or systems (e.g., ⟦{遠隔|えんかく}{操作|そうさ}→遠隔操作：20454_enkakusousa⟧, remote control)
- ⟦{僻地|へきち}→僻地：17059_hekichi⟧ — remote/isolated area; carries a nuance of being undeveloped or hard to access
